title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability exists in Keycloak versions prior to 26.8.1-r1 related to the MariaDB Connector/J used for Java applications connecting to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.9 and impacts the integrity of the system without affecting confidentiality or availability. A patch is available in version 26.8.1-r1 to address this issue.
